name: How much does appliance layout and hookup coordination usually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does appliance layout and hookup coordination usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary based on how much utility work is involved. Simple coordination is mostly planning, but moving a dishwasher, sink, range, or hood can add labor, materials, and possible trade work, so the real cost is driven by plumbing, electrical, gas, and venting changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost depends on whether utilities need to move. Basic planning is less expensive, while relocating plumbing, electrical, gas, or venting can raise the total quickly.
